title: Internal polynomial bar complex and evaluation specification
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative condensed ring with the internal module category of [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data] and [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], using [def-weil-size-convention]. Define a polynomial bar cochain model $P$ of rank $r\in\mathbf N$ by a nonnegative cochain complex of internal $A$-modules, coprojections $\iota_{n,m}:A\to P^n$ indexed by $m:(\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\times\{0,\ldots,r-1\})\to_0\mathbf N$, and the assertion that these coprojections are an internal coproduct. Monomials and substitutions use [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. A finite integer polynomial $q$ specifies the arrow $\sum_m q_m\iota_{n,m}$. On a monomial the differential is that arrow for the alternating sum of substitutions: drop the first block, merge adjacent blocks by addition, drop the last block, with signs $(-1)^i$ for $0\leq i\leq n+1$. This includes $d^0=0$. Extend by zero in negative degrees. For a prime $\ell$, coefficient field $F$ with its normed $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra structure, the continuous scalar ring $A_F$ of [def-sfb-bundled-continuous-scalar-ring] and lattice of [def-sfb-ladic-lattice], define the trivial action on the regular internal module by [def-sfb-condensed-action-module]. For internal-function and bar data of [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data], an evaluation datum is a cochain map from $P$ to that bar on the trivial scalar module such that for every profinite $S$, $c\in C(S,F)$, $T\xrightarrow f S$, tuple $g\in C(T,L^n)$, and $t\in T$, the image of $\iota_{n,m}(c)$ evaluates to $c(f(t))\prod_{a,i}(g_a(t))_i^{m_{a,i}}$, using $\mathbf Z_\ell\to\mathbf Q_\ell\to F$. Empty products are one. These are specifications, with no existence or acyclicity assertion.
